places.name: Moravian Book Shop
places.summary: A bookselling tradition begun in 1745 still anchors Main Street; the appeal is a cozy browsing and coffee pause inside Bethlehem's living Moravian legacy, not another museum ticket.
places.why_go: A bookselling tradition begun in 1745 still anchors Main Street; the appeal is a cozy browsing and coffee pause inside Bethlehem's living Moravian legacy, not another museum ticket.
places.best_fit_note: Best fit: viki and sheluvspaco. Paco: low-pressure flex and coffee; Viki: books, gifts and cozy interior; Gora: institutional continuity and local titles; Stivka: Christian community history and reflective browsing.

hours.note: Year-round retail/cafe hours; holiday and university-calendar exceptions possible.

places.exact_date_feasibility: Monday daytime hours extend through the proposed 16:15-17:00 visit; confirm the university/Barnes & Noble operating calendar for October 5.
places.access_and_safety: Walk a few blocks from Kemerer/downtown lodging. This is an operating shop; secure luggage at the hotel and keep purchases personal.
places.route_fit_note: Walking stop by the sleep node. Replaces Fort Christina, which made day 9 measure 211 minutes when combined with required anchors and Rockwood.

places.name: Black Heritage Trail: Shaw Memorial to Beacon Hill
places.summary: A few blocks expose the organized free Black neighborhood, 54th Massachusetts memory and abolition network that conventional Boston highlight walks often reduce to a footnote.
places.why_go: A few blocks expose the organized free Black neighborhood, 54th Massachusetts memory and abolition network that conventional Boston highlight walks often reduce to a footnote.
places.best_fit_note: Best fit: gora and stivka. Paco: optional 40-minute open-air close; Viki: Beacon Hill streetscape with context; Gora: specific overlooked history tied to the museum visit; Stivka: memorial and conscience walk before rest.

hours.note: Outdoor self-guided route daily; individual buildings are mostly private. Use the NPS app/audio and do not expect interiors after 16:00.

cost.note: Per-person planning estimate; tax, parking, purchases and special-tour fees may differ.

places.exact_date_feasibility: The NPS confirms self-guided trail use at any time Monday-Sunday; 2026 ranger-led tours end September 27. This is a deliberately shortened daylight/dusk segment, not the full 1.6-mile program.
places.access_and_safety: No cars; start at the Shaw/54th Massachusetts Memorial and follow the most relevant Beacon Hill segment to the African Meeting House. Uneven brick and slopes require care; remain together.
places.route_fit_note: Runs after Gardner and ends beside the African Meeting House in time for its 14:30 ticket; it can be shortened for fatigue without removing any anchor.
